title: Building a National Web Community of Philatelists "This is to overcome challenges faced by philatelists across India and to design a solution that enhances their experience and fills up gaps in access to information, raising demand and ensuring fulfillment as per interest for each Philatelic item and ancillaries released and made anywhere in the country through a web based community and a National Philately Deposit Account.
